Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap while finishing second for Ferrari.
Isack Hadjar climbed from twenty-second on the grid to finish tenth and score one point for Red Bull.

review.summary: Taylor Barnard climbed from sixth on the grid to win for DS Penske, with Mahindra's Nyck De Vries second from pole and team-mate Edoardo Mortara third. Taylor Barnard climbed from sixth on the grid to win for DS Penske and claim 25 points.
